description: This file defines the RelaceApi class, an adapter for interacting with the Relace API for language model operations such as chat completion and code application, including methods for streaming and non-streaming interactions, and handling API responses.

classes.name: RelaceApi
classes.description: A class implementing the BaseLlmApi interface to interact with the Relace API for language model functionalities.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Performs a non-streaming chat completion by converting parameters and aggregating streamed chunks.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams chat completion chunks from the Relace API, converting user messages and handling API responses.

methods.name: completionNonStream
methods.description: Throws an error indicating non-support for non-streaming completion.

methods.name: completionStream
methods.description: Throws an error indicating non-support for streaming completion.

methods.name: fimStream
methods.description: Throws an error indicating non-support for FIM streaming.

methods.name: rerank
methods.description: Throws an error indicating non-support for reranking.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Throws an error indicating non-support for listing models.
